preconditions.description: The length of the ciphered text is between 1 and 10,000.
The number of words to consider is between 1 and 100,000.
Each word has a length of at most 1,000 characters.

preconditions.expression: The total length of all words does not exceed 1,000,000.
preconditions.description: The sum of the lengths of all words is at most 1,000,000.

postconditions.expression: The output is a sentence composed of the given words.
postconditions.description: The output sentence must be composed of one or more of the given words.

postconditions.expression: The output sentence is a valid reconstruction of the original sentence.
postconditions.description: The output sentence must be a valid reconstruction of the original sentence that was ciphered using the specified method.

postconditions.expression: The output sentence is composed of lowercase letters.
postconditions.description: All letters in the output sentence must be in lowercase.
